name: 3 Nen B Gumi Kinpachi-sensei - Densetsu no Kyoudan ni Tate!
original_name: 3年B組金八先生 伝説の教壇に立て!
source:
You can become the homeroom teacher of "Class 3-B" from the [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生]popular TV drama[/url]!

You take care of 21 students from Class B in the 3rd year (including transfer students). The game progresses episode by episode like a television show, and resolve the worries and troubles of the students that occur each episode.

And the story takes an unexpected turn...

Will you be able to get your students to graduate safely?

[Translated from [url=https://www.spike-chunsoft.co.jp/games/3b/info.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
你可以从高中毕业就成为“3-B班”的班主任[url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生]热门电视剧[/url]！

你照顾三年级B班的21名学生（包括转学生）。游戏像电视剧一样一集一集地进行，解决学生每一集出现的担忧和烦恼。

而故事却发生了意想不到的转折……

你能让你的学生安全毕业吗？

[译自[url=https://www.spike-chunsoft.co.jp/games/3b/info.html]官方网站[/url]]
